## Lab Director

::: {.person}
### Yizhou “Louis” Liu, PhD

**Assistant Professor, Department of Psychology**  
**The University of Alabama in Huntsville**

Dr. Liu’s research focuses on cognitive psychology, decision-making, human-computer interaction, and intervention design. His work examines how cognitive, emotional, and contextual factors including stress, fatigue, and interface design influence internet users’ privacy-related decisions. He uses experimental methods, advanced statistical modeling, and user-centered design approaches to develop interventions that facilitate more informed decision-making, reduce stress, and improve users’ experiences with technology. Outside of work, he enjoys playing tennis and soccer, staying active, and spending time with family.


**Research interests:** Decision-Making, Human-Computer Interaction, Intervention and Training, User-centered Design
:::
